name: SimpleSearch-VL
title: SimpleSearch-VL: A Simple Recipe for Multimodal Agentic Deep Search
authors: Ming Dai, Zhihong Lu, Jinjie Gu, Jiedong Zhuang, Yefeng Liu, Wankou Yang, Jian Wang, Chunhua Shen
summary: Learning to search, reason, and verify across visual and textual evidence with efficient agentic reinforcement learning.
highlights: **SimpleSearch-VL** is an efficient, reliable, and practical framework for **multimodal agentic deep search**. It improves the agent's search-and-verification process with **Factorized Adaptive Rollout**, evidence-verified reasoning, and self-summarized visits, achieving strong search behavior from only 5K SFT trajectories and 2K RL prompts.
figure_alt: SimpleSearch-VL: visual evidence verification and search workflow

name: ScanFocus
title: ScanFocus: A Coarse-to-Fine Framework for Spatio-Temporal Video Grounding
authors: Kai Chen*, Ming Dai*, Wenxuan Cheng, Wankou Yang
summary: From a global scan to local refinement: precise spatio-temporal grounding through semantic-motion fusion.
highlights: **ScanFocus** is a **coarse-to-fine** framework for spatio-temporal video grounding, decoupling global spatio-temporal scanning from local boundary refinement. It introduces **Deformable Semantic-Motion Fusion** for coarse proposal generation and **SGTA** for dense boundary-focused temporal modeling, improving precise timestamp regression.

name: VideoSEG-O3
title: VideoSEG-O3: A Multi-turn Reinforcement Learning Framework for Reasoning Video Object Segmentation
authors: Ming Dai, Sen Yang, Boqiang Duan, Boyuan Tong, Jiedong Zhuang, Wankou Yang, Jingdong Wang
summary: An agent that actively explores when and where to look, aligning multi-turn reasoning with pixel-level segmentation.
highlights: **VideoSEG-O3** is a **multi-turn RL** framework for RVOS, actively exploring temporal intervals and keyframes through temporal-spatial CoT instead of relying on fixed sampled frames. It further introduces **SEG-aware logit calibration** and a decoupled thinking trace, aligning token-level policy optimization with pixel-level mask quality.
figure_alt: VideoSEG-O3: iterative temporal-spatial exploration and segmentation

name: DeRVOS
title: DeRVOS: Decoupling Consistent Trajectory Generation and Multimodal Understanding for Referring Video Object Segmentation
authors: Wenxuan Cheng*, Ming Dai*, Huimin Lu, Wankou Yang
summary: Decoupling consistent trajectory generation from multimodal understanding for robust referring video segmentation.
highlights: **DeRVOS** decouples **trajectory generation** and **multimodal understanding**, with `TAIS` aligning and selecting instance trajectories for robust RVOS.

name: MomentSeg
title: MomentSeg: Moment-Centric Sampling for Enhanced Video Pixel Understanding
authors: Ming Dai, Sen Yang, Boqiang Duan, Wankou Yang, Jingdong Wang
summary: Unifying temporal grounding and pixel understanding to find the moments that matter in a video.
highlights: **MomentSeg** is a **MLLM** method, which unifies **temporal grounding** and **segmentation**, enabling key-frame extraction *without* relying on any external models. In addition, we introduce a novel `[FIND]` token, which allows the model to perform temporal grounding *without* requiring any additional timestamp encoding.
figure_alt: MomentSeg: moment-centric sampling, video segmentation, and benchmark performance

name: InstanceVG
title: Improving Generalized Visual Grounding with Instance-aware Joint Learning
venue: IEEE Transactions on Pattern Analysis and Machine Intelligence (TPAMI) · 2025
authors: Ming Dai, Wenxuan Cheng, Jiang-jiang Liu, Lingfeng Yang, Zhenhua Feng, Wankou Yang, Jingdong Wang
summary: Instance-aware learning for generalized grounding, with consistent point, box, and mask predictions.
highlights: **InstanceVG** supports **instance-level** referring segmentation across general scenarios (no/single/multiple targets). It also provides consistent prediction across `point`, `box`, and `mask`.
figure_alt: InstanceVG network architecture: point-guided instance queries and joint box-mask prediction

name: PropVG
title: PropVG: End-to-End Proposal-Driven Visual Grounding with Multi-Granularity Discrimination
authors: Ming Dai, Wenxuan Cheng, Jiedong Zhuang, Jiang-jiang Liu, Hongshen Zhao, Zhenhua Feng, Wankou Yang
summary: End-to-end proposal-driven grounding with multi-granularity discrimination.
highlights: **PropVG** achieves **end-to-end two-stage** visual grounding, overcoming the traditional drawbacks of previous two-stage approaches that *relied on external detectors* and were often associated with *slow inference and limited performance*.

name: DeRIS
title: DeRIS: Decoupling Perception and Cognition for Enhanced Referring Image Segmentation through Loopback Synergy
authors: Ming Dai, Wenxuan Cheng, Jiang-jiang Liu, Sen Yang, Wenxiao Cai, Yanpeng Sun, Wankou Yang
summary: Connecting visual perception and language cognition through loopback synergy.
highlights: **DeRIS** analyzes a key bottleneck in visual grounding—**Cognition**. It decouples the VG task into *perception* and *cognition* components, and integrates them effectively through a loopback synergy mechanism.

name: GC3VG
title: GC3VG: Generalized Multi-task Visual Grounding with Coarse-to-Fine Consistency Constraints
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT) · 2025
authors: Ming Dai, Kai Chen, Wenxuan Cheng, Jiedong Zhuang, Zhenhua Feng, Pengfei Zhu, Wankou Yang
summary: Generalized multi-task grounding with region alignment and coarse-to-fine consistency.
highlights: **GC3VG** generalizes the **C3VG** architecture and incorporates `UCRM`, which implicitly captures region/instance features and explicitly aligns them via an IoU-based relational constraint. The `GHA` strategy ensures feature-space consistency and boosts the discriminative strength of multi-modal representations.

name: C3VG
title: Multi-task Visual Grounding with Coarse-to-Fine Consistency Constraints
authors: Ming Dai, Jian Li, Jiedong Zhuang, Xian Zhang, Wankou Yang
summary: Bringing referring localization and segmentation together through consistent multi-task learning.
highlights: **C3VG** investigates the **consistency** prediction problem in REC and RIS, introducing a **coarse-to-fine** architecture that enforces consistency through both `implicit` and `explicit` constraints.

name: SimVG
title: SimVG: A Simple Framework for Visual Grounding with Decoupled Multi-modal Fusion
authors: Ming Dai, Lingfeng Yang, Yihao Xu, Zhenhua Feng, Wankou Yang
summary: A simple approach to visual grounding through decoupled multimodal fusion and synchronized distillation.
highlights: **SimVG** explores the importance of **multi-modal understanding** for the VG task, proposing a **simple** yet effective framework. It also adopts a **synchronized distillation** learning strategy between the teacher and student branches, enhancing the performance of the student branch.
figure_alt: SimVG network architecture: decoupled multimodal fusion and dynamic weight-balance distillation

name: DRL
title: Drone Referring Localization: An Efficient Heterogeneous Spatial Feature Interaction Method For UAV Self-Localization
authors: Ming Dai, Enhui Zheng, Jiahao Chen, Lei Qi, Zhenhua Feng, Wankou Yang
summary: End-to-end UAV self-localization through efficient heterogeneous spatial feature interaction.
highlights: **DRL** adopts an **end-to-end** training and inference paradigm to address common issues in image-retrieval-based UAV self-localization, including *complex preprocessing*, *inherent localization errors*, and *slow inference*.

name: DenseUAV
title: Vision-Based UAV Self-Positioning in Low-Altitude Urban Environments
authors: Ming Dai, Enhui Zheng, Zhenhua Feng, Jiedong Zhuang, Wankou Yang
summary: A real-world dataset and benchmark for vision-based UAV localization in low-altitude urban environments.
highlights: **DenseUAV** introduces a **real-world** sampled dataset for vision-based UAV self-localization and provides a comprehensive benchmark for the task.
figure_alt: DenseUAV: drone and satellite views at different altitudes and across years

name: FSRA
title: A Transformer-Based Feature Segmentation and Region Alignment Method For UAV-View Geo-Localization
venue: IEEE Transactions on Circuits and Systems for Video Technology (TCSVT) · 2021
authors: Ming Dai, Jianhong Hu, Jiedong Zhuang, Enhui Zheng
summary: Transformer-based feature segmentation and region alignment for cross-view geo-localization.
highlights: **FSRA** is the *first* successful application of Transformer models to cross-view geo-localization. It introduces an attention-map-based region partitioning and alignment strategy that alleviates performance degradation caused by viewpoint shifts.
